fullPassage: In the 1950s, biologists observed chimpanzees that weren't biologically related sharing meat. They struggled to understand why animals that aren't part of the same family help one another. Today, it is believed that the answer is related to game theory. To understand this concept better, consider the following situation. Tournaments were once held by a political scientist in which computer programs competed against each other. Each program had a specific strategy that it followed when encountering an opponent — cooperating with it, backing down from it, and so on. A strategy emerged over time that was more successful than others: start by being cooperative, and then simply copy your opponents' behavior. In other words, if they cooperate, I cooperate. If they stop sharing with me, I stop sharing with them. The behavior we observe in the animal kingdom that is similar to this is called reciprocity. The chimpanzees share food with others because they believe the other will return the favor.

questions.passage: In the 1950s, biologists observed chimpanzees that weren't biologically related sharing meat. They struggled to understand why animals that aren't part of the same family help one another. Today, it is believed that the answer is related to game theory. To understand this concept better, consider the following situation. Tournaments were once held by a political scientist in which computer programs competed against each other. Each program had a specific strategy that it followed when encountering an opponent — cooperating with it, backing down from it, and so on. A strategy emerged over time that was more successful than others: start by being cooperative, and then simply copy your opponents' behavior. In other words, if they cooperate, I cooperate. If they stop sharing with me, I stop sharing with them. The behavior we observe in the animal kingdom that is similar to this is called reciprocity. The chimpanzees share food with others because they believe the other will return the favor.
questions.stem: 위 글에서, 각 프로그램이 상대를 만났을 때 따랐던 것이 무엇인지 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (3단어, 영어로)

det.korean: a specific strategy = 특정한 전략
det.analysis: 본문 6번째 문장 'Each program had a specific strategy that it followed when encountering an opponent' — 각 프로그램이 따랐던 것 = a specific strategy
det.tip: had a specific strategy → 따랐던 것 = a specific strategy

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심: 혈연이 아닌 동물의 협력을 게임 이론(호혜성)으로 설명
det.analysis:
① 고기 나눔 방식: 도입부 예시일 뿐, 주제 아님
② 실험의 한계: 한계는 언급 없음
③ 게임 이론 개발 배경: 개발 역사가 아니라 적용
④ 게임 이론으로 설명되는 동물의 호혜적 행동 ←정답
det.tip: 전체 흐름: 침팬지 협력 관찰 → 게임 이론 → 호혜성(reciprocity)

ch: 침팬지가 고기를 나누어 먹는 다양한 방식
컴퓨터 프로그램을 이용한 동물 실험의 한계
정치학자들이 게임 이론을 개발한 역사적 배경

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 동물의 비혈연 협력 = 호혜성(상대의 보답 기대)
det.analysis:
① 혈연이 아닌 동물의 협력 = 호혜성으로 설명 ←정답
② 본능 결정: 본문은 호혜성(게임 이론)으로 설명, 본능이 아님
③ 인간 사회에만: 동물계에 적용하므로 오류
④ 경쟁 승리 전략: 글의 초점은 협력·호혜성
det.tip: 마지막: 침팬지는 상대의 보답을 믿어 나눔 = 호혜성

ch: 혈연이 아닌 동물의 협력은 상대의 보답을 기대하는 호혜성으로 설명된다.
동물의 이타적 행동은 전적으로 본능에 의해 결정된다.
게임 이론은 인간 사회에만 적용할 수 있는 개념이다.
경쟁에서 이기려면 상대의 전략을 먼저 파악해야 한다.
